_provenance.supersedes: The Master Draft WP structure of fieldwise-run-01 (WP1 Historical Data and Target Design .. WP5 Operational Transfer, Decision Value and Web MVP, 32 tasks, D1.1-D5.5). The Pack §3.1 restructures the work plan: WP3 becomes the independent commercial-farmer prospective validation, WP4 the continuous DrR web-MVP co-development, WP5 the AgroVIR placement; MVCRI leaves the in-action plan. Task/deliverable/milestone identifiers below follow the Pack, so same-name ids (e.g. D5.1) do NOT mean the same artifact as in the superseded structure.
_provenance.partner_tokens: lead is the Pack's month-line string, verbatim. lead_role_tokens maps its names to the run-02 role tokens (HOST = HUN-REN ATK, EO_PARTNER = ELTE, DATA_PARTNER = MATE, SOFTWARE_PARTNER = Krumatic, VALIDATION_PARTNER = AgroVIR, VALIDATION_SITE = commercial farmer). The FELLOW executes all work packages in this single-researcher action; where the Pack's month line names 'Fellow' explicitly, that is recorded but the token is not repeated as a lead.
_provenance.scope_note: Work packages, month ranges, participant lines, tasks, deliverables and milestones are Pack-Confirmed. D1.3 (Career Development Plan) is operator-preserved from the CC-13 instrument mandate — it is additional to the Pack's deliverable list, unchanged in owner and due month. Task-level months for the merged WP1 are Confirmed per the OD-1 partner-backed answer; other WPs inherit their ranges (Inferred, rule stated below). Inter-WP dependency edges are Inferred with derivations stated. Person-months are operator rulings of 2026-08-28: the fellow's split ratified in session; partner in-kind figures per the effort-table ruling, all Assumed and declared.
_provenance.od1_merge_2026_09_02: OD-1 ADOPTION (partner-backed answer, decision_log/fieldwise-run03-instantiation_2026-09-02.json): the former WP1 (M1-M6) and WP2 (M3-M14) are MERGED into a single WP1 'Data Harmonisation, Stress Definition and Model Development' spanning M1-M14. Task-level timing inside the merged WP: T1.1-T1.5 at M1-M2 (harmonisation and target definition), T2.1-T2.3 at M2-M3 ending in the model freeze (new milestone MS6, M3: primary model frozen and registered before the first prospective field season), T2.4-T2.6 at M4-M14 (scale harmonisation, DrR configuration, crop-transfer specification — explicitly non-target-model work). ID STABILITY RULE: task ids (T1.x, T2.x), deliverable ids (D1.x, D2.x) and the remaining WP ids (WP3, WP4, WP5) are deliberately NOT renumbered — renumbering would silently re-target every existing cross-reference (e.g. 'T2.6', 'WP2') in Tier 3, Tier 4 and the plans. The container 'WP2' ceases to exist; any residual reference to WP2-as-container is a detectable dangling reference, not a silent misreference. DISPLAY MAPPING for evaluator-facing text (applied at drafting/condensation, recorded here as the single authority): WP1->'WP1', WP3->'WP2', WP4->'WP3', WP5->'WP4'; task/deliverable display ids follow their displayed WP number.
